notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR18 puts the destination count's validity on the user ("It is the responsibility of the user to insure that the value ... is valid"); it asks nothing of the implementation beyond GR17, and an invalid value is detected, not undefined: ValidCount answers status 30 for a value outside 1..integer-1 or not an unsigned integer (CommunicationArea.DestinationCount is null then). Probes at 85: non-numeric "AB12", spaces, 0, 9999 gave 30 on SEND, PURGE, ENABLE and DISABLE OUTPUT; the witness's valid count 1 delivers one message with status 00.

next.reason: 1985: "the value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 is valid at the time of execution of the SEND, PURGE, ENABLE OUTPUT"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; the communication module and its SEND/PURGE statements are absent.". No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry, and no wording candidate covers it or SEND/PURGE/ENABLE OUTPUT, so the feature and this user-responsibility rule are dropped.
